title: The $15,000 Debt That Slows Your Savings Growth

scenes.text: A $15,000 credit‑card debt can stall your savings for years.
The average U.S. credit‑card debt is $7,400 with a 17% APR, costing $1,250 interest annually.
A $15,000 balance at 17% takes 9 years to pay off if you only pay the minimum ($225/month).
Your credit‑card debt is not just interest—it's also a drain on your potential investment returns.
